ekranHook: He wanted to go home early

pencereler.0-5: Fire broke out inside the nuclear submarine Miami at a shipyard in Maine. It
pencereler.5-12: spread through crew, command and torpedo spaces, and burned for twelve hours. The submarine was in overhaul. The first
pencereler.12-20: report blamed a vacuum cleaner. Then a shipyard worker confessed. He lit rags on a bunk so he could leave work early.
pencereler.20-30: He was sentenced to more than seventeen years. The submarine was decommissioned instead of repaired.

segmentler.metin: USS Miami was destroyed by fire during an overhaul.
It took only a shipyard worker lighting rags in a berthing compartment.
So how could a shipyard worker lighting rags in a berthing compartment do this?
The answer is arson in a submarine under overhaul, spreading through crew, command and torpedo spaces — and it is why the submarine was decommissioned instead of repaired.
